preflight.referenceHarnessDifference: Frozen reference predates owned buffered-mode flags/report metadata and cold options validation. Actual shared warm driver, complete response checker, HTTP/native kernels and reference-specific code remain identical; full harness files are identical between source base/head.
preflight.scope: One fixed5-block two-payload four-worker affected source event, both Rust fixtures, coallocated references and leaf buffer codecs,64requests per client. Complete final-head dual-compiler/platform CI remains required. Earlier shorter request-count events and allocation-only diagnostics are separate; no pooled timing or reused prefix. Workstation background applications and externally owned tests/builds remain uncontrolled and are explicitly recorded. No owned heavy work overlaps timing; no physical isolation or controlled release acceptance claim. Waiting for every foreign project to become idle cannot establish isolation and is not a requirement for this advisory event. This reference-inspection event checks four affected Go root packages, affected LLGo canonical/component/P2/P3 packages and the nested P3 module; full final-head32-package LLGo matrix remains required. Counts are identical for sources and references; old observations are not reused or pooled.
